resource: Entries in one OPEN_CONTAINER view (domain 11 snapshot type 1 or delta type 1)
allocation_impact: The decoder refuses a 31st corpse entry before decoding it and any payload over 941 bytes (the container handle and 30 entries of at most 31 bytes) before reading it; the encoder refuses the same view before emitting a byte.
boundary_tests: max=30: a corpse with 30 entries round-trips within 941 bytes
max+1=31: 31 entries are refused in both directions
notes: ITEM-MOVE-WIRE-0 §4.4, amended by SUMMER owner decision 20: the corpse view capacity is equal to GAMEITEM01-CORPSE-CONTAINER-ENTRIES-MAX. Within FND02-STATE-DELTA-PAYLOAD-BYTES and FND02-SNAPSHOT-CHUNK-BYTES.
